spec.name: Orange Kitchen Soy
spec.description: A harvested sprig of three plump green soybean pods, each with three distinct bean chambers, tapered ends and a raised natural seam. Stepped leaflets and clipped stems complete the fresh edamame silhouette. The central pod rests at y=0.

prompt: Orange SMP Kitchen cohesive premium Minecraft vanilla voxel art. Appetizing recognizable silhouette and deliberate connected pixel shading, material detail and highlights. No plain untextured cubes, random noise, letters or scenery. Use ONE well-mapped 64x64 atlas; per-face UV islands, not repeated generic material tiles. Keep texture palette cohesive: warm golden bread, fresh greens, ivory rice, rich salmon, warm ceramics. Geometry should be carefully stepped and rounded where appropriate, with purposeful tiny details. 20-55 cuboids as appropriate, stay within Java model bounds -16..32. Item ground bottom y0. Strong inventory readability. Create Soy. Recognizable harvested produce matching the exact species; natural stepped silhouette and species-specific skin/leaf detail.
